job.title: [Post] We're Hiring: Senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Consultant Experience: 8+ Years Key…

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Consultant | 5+ Years B2B E-Commerce Development
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) B2B solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and micro-services. Proven track record designing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, data pipelines and migrations. Skilled in functional analysis, user-story creation, stakeholder management and AI-assisted development. Agile, CI/CD-driven and SAP-certified.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Consultant
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Charan Teja’s focus on delivering cutting-edge B2B commerce solutions. With 5+ years leading SAP Commerce (Hybris) implementations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep functional and technical expertise that aligns perfectly with this senior consultant role.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, covering product catalog, pricing and order management for global B2B customers.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to elicit requirements, write user stories and functional specs, then translate them into robust SAP Commerce features.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, and resolved complex ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks.

bullets.label: Leadership & Delivery
bullets.text: Led code reviews, mentored junior developers and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, ensuring high-quality releases in Agile teams.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Charan Teja’s reputation for pioneering B2B SAP Commerce transformations resonates with my passion for delivering scalable, AI-enhanced e-commerce platforms. I admire your commitment to innovation and global client success, and I am eager to contribute my SAP Hybris functional expertise to drive your next generation of commerce solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: To apply my SAP Commerce functional expertise and drive innovative B2B solutions within Charan Teja’s forward-thinking team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce (Hybris) functional specialist with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’d love to discuss how I can add value to Charan Teja’s senior consultant role. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Consultant
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Consultant position. I bring over five years of hands-on SAP Commerce experience, strong functional consulting skills, and a proven record of delivering B2B e-commerce solutions. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Charan Teja.

Best regards,
